title: 1984 Topps League Leaders #134 Rickey Henderson & Tim Raines
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText: This 1984 Topps League Leaders sports trading card features two legendary baseball players, Rickey Henderson and Tim Raines. The card is part of the base set and has a card number of 134. It is perfect for collectors who are fans of the Oakland Athletics or Montreal Expos and want to add a piece of Major League Baseball (MLB) history to their collection. The card is in great shape and is a must-have for any baseball fan.
